title: SK Group chairman says Anthropic asked SK Hynix for chip supplies
reason: Wire-exclusive check (verification.md §2): the underlying claim -- Anthropic asked SK Hynix for chip-manufacturing supplies to build its own custom semiconductors -- traces to one origin: SK Group chairman Chey Tae-won's on-stage remarks with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei at a San Francisco AI event, first reported by Bloomberg (2026-07-25). Fortune's and other outlets' text is the same Bloomberg wire content verbatim (identical 'Anthropic PBC' phrasing), not independent reporting. Business claims need >=2 independent Tier<=2 sources or a filing/document per §3; a company statement would also clear the bar, but neither Anthropic nor SK Hynix has issued its own confirming statement distinct from the chairman's quote as relayed by Bloomberg. Held as watching rather than published.
watch: A second outlet with its own reporting (not relaying Bloomberg's wire text) confirming the chairman's remarks or adding independent detail
An Anthropic or SK Hynix statement/filing on the custom chip supply request
Any follow-up detail on chip type (ASIC vs GPU) or timeline, which the current Bloomberg-derived coverage does not specify
notes: 2026-07-25 c3: opened from a candidate handed over by cycle 2 (dedup-check already run then, moderate matches against amd-anthropic-compute-deal and sk-hynix-nasdaq-ipo, unread at the time). Read both matched articles this cycle -- confirmed coincidental (amd-anthropic-compute-deal is AMD's own GPU supply deal, unrelated company/claim; sk-hynix-nasdaq-ipo covers SK Hynix's Nasdaq listing/valuation, not a chip supply request). Re-ran dedup-check with a fuller title: moderate match (0.375) against sk-hynix-nasdaq-ipo only, confirmed coincidental for the same reason. No independent second source or company statement found. Gate fails on the independence rule. Holding as watching.
